obituaries.full_text:
Rachel M. Hughes Green 84, of Gouldtown, NJ passed away on Monday evening February 
 23, 2015 after a short battle with cancer. A lifelong resident of Gouldtown, 
 she was born July 2, 1930 , the daughter of the late John Romaine and Ariana 
 (nee Gould) Hughes, and the wife of the late Wayne Green.
